Year-round Climate
Wuxi has a subtropical monsoon climate with four distinct seasons. Lingshan Scenic Area is near Taihu Lake with humid microclimate, average annual temperature 15-16°C.
Spring (Mar-May)
Temperature 10-22°C, nature revives with blooming flowers. Ideal for spring outing. Bring light jacket.
Summer (Jun-Aug)
Temperature 25-35°C, occasional heat waves. Lush green scenery. Bring sunscreen and water. Visit Buddhist Palace for afternoon shelter.
Autumn (Sep-Nov)
Temperature 15-25°C, clear skies with autumn foliage. Best season for visiting. Wear comfortable long sleeves.
Winter (Dec-Feb)
Temperature 0-8°C, occasional snow. Beautiful snow scenery at Buddhist Palace. Wear warm down jacket. Watch temperature changes between indoor/outdoor.
Outfit Suggestions
Lots of walking, wear comfortable sneakers. Remove shoes for indoor sites like Buddhist Palace. Bring sun hat in summer, scarf/gloves in winter.
